name: Truckee River Fund (Community Foundation of Northern Nevada)
summary: Grants for projects that protect and improve water quality in the Truckee River watershed, such as invasive species control, erosion reduction, revegetation after fire and creek rehabilitation. Registered nonprofits and government entities apply.

status.quote: The deadline for proposals is Friday, July 24, 2026, at noon.

deadline.quote: The deadline for proposals is Friday, July 24, 2026, at noon.

applicant_types.quote: Applicants must be registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit agencies, nonprofit educational institutions, or governmental entities.

geography.quote: The mission of the Truckee River Fund is to protect and enhance the water quality and water resources of the Truckee River and its watershed.

access.quote: For more information and to begin your grant application

window.quote: Truckee River Fund (opens in January and June)

amount.quote: grants will typically be funded between $5,000-$100,000.

co_finance_required.quote: All applicants must provide a match of at least 25% for the dollars requested.
